cards.ex: They airbrushed out her wrinkles in the magazine cover photo.
cards.exUz: Jurnal muqovasi suratida ular uning ajinlarini retush qilib tashlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Suratdagi kamchiliklarni yo'qotish uchun uni o'zgartirmoq, tuzatmoq.

cards.ex: Our marketing strategy includes a lot of below-the-line promotion, like sponsoring local events.
cards.exUz: Bizning marketing strategiyamizda ko'plab bilvosita reklama usullari bor, masalan, mahalliy tadbirlarga homiylik qilish.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri bo'lmagan reklama usullari (masalan, homiylik).

cards.ex: That article about the CEO was clearly just a puff piece.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor haqidagi maqola aniqki, faqatgina maqtov maqola edi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir juda ijobiy ko'rsatadigan maqola.

cards.ex: The newspaper's reputation suffered because of their reliance on yellow journalism.
cards.exUz: Gazetaning obro'si sariq matbuotga tayanganligi sababli yomonlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Sensatsiya ortidan quvish, asossiz xabarlar tarqatish.

cards.ex: The scandal was front-page news for weeks.
cards.exUz: Bu janjal bir necha hafta davomida birinchi sahifada yozildi.
cards.uzDef: Juda muhim yangilik, gazetaning birinchi sahifasida chop etiladi.

cards.ex: The article buried the lead; I had to read halfway through to find out what it was really about.
cards.exUz: Maqola muhim joyni yashirdi; nima haqida ekanligini bilish uchun yarmigacha o'qishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Eng muhim faktni oxiriga qo'yish, o'quvchiga qiyinlashtirmoq.

cards.ex: The trial became a media circus, with reporters camped outside the courthouse.
cards.exUz: Sud jarayoni media shov-shuviga aylandi, muxbirlar sud binosi tashqarisida lager qurishdi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy axborot vositalarining juda katta e'tibori, ko'pincha salbiy ma'noda.

cards.ex: The movie had blatant product placement throughout.
cards.exUz: Film davomida mahsulotni ochiqchasiga joylashtirish ko'p edi.
cards.uzDef: Film yoki ko'rsatuvda mahsulotni yashirincha reklama qilish.

cards.ex: The video of the dancing cat became a viral sensation overnight.
cards.exUz: Raqsga tushayotgan mushuk videosi bir kechada ommaviy mashhurlikka erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Internetda tez tarqalib, juda mashhur bo'lib ketgan narsa.

cards.ex: She's a brand ambassador for several luxury fashion brands.
cards.exUz: U bir nechta hashamatli moda brendlarining brend elchisi.
cards.uzDef: Brendni targ'ib qiluvchi mashhur shaxs.

cards.ex: The new phone is generating a lot of buzz online.
cards.exUz: Yangi telefon internetda ko'p shov-shuv yaratmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'z atrofida qiziqish va gap-so'zlar paydo qilmoq.

cards.ex: You could tell the article had a strong editorial slant against the new law.
cards.exUz: Maqolaning yangi qonunga qarshi kuchli muharrirlik nuqtai nazariga ega ekanligini aytishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Maqolaning muallifning sub'ektiv fikriga mos kelishi.

cards.ex: In today's 24-hour news cycle, stories come and go quickly.
cards.exUz: Bugungi 24 soatlik yangiliklar aylanishida hikoyalar tez keladi va ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Yangiliklarning yaratilishi, tarqalishi va eskirishi davri.

cards.ex: The company is trying to do some spin control after the negative press.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya salbiy matbuotdan keyin ma'lumotni boshqarishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Xabarni ijobiy ko'rinishda taqdim etishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The movie studio launched a media blitz to promote their new film.
cards.exUz: Kino studiyasi yangi filmini targ'ib qilish uchun media hujumini boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Reklama va e'lonlarning juda kuchli kampaniyasi.

cards.ex: The advertising campaign was tailored to a specific demographic profile.
cards.exUz: Reklama kampaniyasi muayyan demografik tavsifga moslashtirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Aholining yoshi, jinsi, daromadi va hokazolar bo'yicha tavsifi.

cards.ex: The magazine is going to press tonight, so we need to finalize the layout.
cards.exUz: Jurnal bugun kechqurun bosmaga jo'natiladi, shuning uchun biz tartibni yakunlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Gazetani yoki kitobni chop etishga tayyorlash.

cards.ex: The actors went on a press junket to promote their new movie.
cards.exUz: Aktyorlar yangi filmini targ'ib qilish uchun press-turga borishdi.
cards.uzDef: Film yoki mahsulotni targ'ib qilish uchun tashkil etilgan sayohat.

cards.ex: It's important to be able to distinguish between real news and fake news.
cards.exUz: Haqiqiy yangiliklar va soxta yangiliklarni ajrata olish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqiy yangiliklarga o'xshatib yaratilgan yolg'on ma'lumotlar.

cards.ex: The movie studio's hype machine is in full swing.
cards.exUz: Kino studiyasining reklama mashinasi to'liq kuch bilan ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani haddan tashqari reklama qilish uchun ishlatiladigan tashkilot.

cards.ex: The reporter managed to get the scoop on the scandal.
cards.exUz: Muxbir janjal haqida birinchi bo'lib ma'lumot olishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Birinchi bo'lib eksklyuziv yangilikni bilib olmoq.

cards.ex: The politician stayed on message during the interview.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi intervyu davomida asosiy g'oyaga sodiq qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Doim bir xil asosiy g'oyani yetkazish.

cards.ex: The company is trying to create a buzz around its new product.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yangi mahsuloti atrofida qiziqish uyg'otishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida qiziqish uyg'otmoq.

cards.ex: The politician floated a trial balloon about raising taxes.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi soliqni oshirish haqida sinov sharini uchirdi.
cards.uzDef: Reaksiyani tekshirish uchun g'oyani e'lon qilish.

cards.ex: The company is working hard to stay relevant in the changing media landscape.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'zgaruvchan media muhitida dolzarb bo'lib qolish uchun qattiq ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'z ahamiyatini saqlab qolish, hozirgi tendentsiyalarga moslashish.

cards.ex: Influencer marketing has become a popular way for brands to reach new customers.
cards.exUz: Influenser marketing brendlarning yangi xaridorlarga erishishining mashhur usuliga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur odamlar orqali mahsulotni reklama qilish.

cards.ex: I get so many push notifications from news apps that it's distracting.
cards.exUz: Menga yangiliklar ilovalaridan shunchalik ko'p bildirishnomalar keladiki, bu chalg'itadi.
cards.uzDef: Mobil ilovalar orqali yuboriladigan xabarlar.

cards.ex: The show is going off the air after 10 successful seasons.
cards.exUz: Ko'rsatuv 10 muvaffaqiyatli mavsumdan so'ng efirdan uziladi.
cards.uzDef: Radio yoki televideniye dasturining tugashi.

cards.ex: The two companies are doing a cross-promotion to reach each other's customers.
cards.exUz: Ikki kompaniya bir-birining mijozlariga erishish uchun o'zaro reklama qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ikki yoki undan ortiq kompaniya birgalikda reklama qilishi.

cards.ex: The company has high brand recognition thanks to its effective advertising campaigns.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning samarali reklama kampaniyalari tufayli brendni tanish darajasi yuqori.
cards.uzDef: Brendni bilish va eslay olish qobiliyati.
